summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with D. Boral Capital LLC dated October 1, 2026, permitting sales of Class A Ordinary Shares up to a $100,000,000 aggregate offering price under an at-the-market program. The shares are issued under an effective Form F-3 shelf registration (File No. 333-295047) and an accompanying Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement. D. Boral acts as sales agent or principal on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with a 2.5% commission; the company is not obligated to sell. This routine capital-raising shelf takedown presents share overhang rather than a special situation; watch dilution pace and pricing relative to Nasdaq trading.
